300:t_2:48.en:
$n
「Better...? You're the one who was down, $$スズネ$$.」

300:t_2:52.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you, $n. Lately... all I do is get help from you.」

300:t_2:53.en:
$n
「Was I able to repay you a little?」

300:t_2:54.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You finished repaying that long ago...」

300:t_2:56.en:
$n
「...I've been thinking about it this whole time. What can someone like me, who's always had everyone's help, do with $$ジェニオン$$...」

300:t_2:57.en:
$n
「As my answer, I've been fighting, trying to get stronger so I could protect someone, but...」

300:t_2:58.en:
$n
「Only recently have I started to understand, just a little, that what I was lacking is strength in the true sense.」

300:t_2:60.en:
$n
「Not clinging to convenient hopes, and not going reckless in despair, but doing what I'm supposed to do...」

300:t_2:61.en:
$n
「When I can do that... I think I'll be able to get even stronger.」

300:t_2:62.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Could you mean that time at $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

300:t_2:63.en:
$n
「In that moment... I felt like I'd gotten past something, just a little.」

300:t_2:64.en:
$n
(If I can gain that strength, then surely Mom too...)

300:t_2:66.en:
$n
「An encrypted comm code...! It's a transmission from someone in $c!」

300:t_2:68.en:
$n
「I knew it, there were other survivors besides us!」

300:t_2:69.en:
$n
「We can't wait for morning. Let's go, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

300:t_2:71.en:
$$スズネ$$
(What do I do... Even in a situation like this... my heart won't stop pounding...)

300:t_2:72.en:
$$スズネ$$
(...I've decided, $n... No matter what happens, I'll follow you...)

300:t_2:73.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Even if the end of the world is closing in, I believe in the strength you're aiming for.)

300:t_2:77.en: ～ Kingdom of $$クメン$$, $$アッセンブルＥＸ－１０$$ ～

300:t_2:78.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「...Your wounds seem to be completely healed, $$キリコ$$.」

300:t_2:79.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Thanks for taking care of me, $$ポタリア$$.」

300:t_2:80.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Still, you surprised me. You looked like all you could do was wait to die, and you're up and moving after a single week.」

300:t_2:82.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「You lot who came staggering into $$クメン$$ in tatters are about the same.」

300:t_2:83.en:
$$スザク$$
「Thank you, $$ポタリア$$, $$キデーラ$$.」

300:t_2:84.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Without your protection, we would certainly have been wiped out.」

300:t_2:85.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Heh... Getting thanked by the famous leader of the $$黒の騎士団$$ makes me feel all ticklish.」

300:t_2:86.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「We'd heard about $c's exploits, but to think you'd be scattered by the $$時空震動$$...」

300:t_2:87.en:
$$カレン$$
「Still, we were lucky. Where we got thrown was near $$クメン$$.」

300:t_2:89.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(It's too perfect to be coincidence... This must be the work of $$キリコ$$'s power as an $$異能生存体$$.)

300:t_2:90.en:
$$マオ$$
「Still, I can't believe $$クメン$$ was still resisting the Empire...」

300:t_2:91.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「Even after the civil war, this country kept fighting against the old $$地球連邦$$'s annexation policy. Even the citizens are used to guerrilla warfare.」

300:t_2:92.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Funny thing for a mercenary like me to say, but the folks here are hardened resistance fighters.」

300:t_2:93.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「So it's the same as $$新日本$$.」

300:t_2:94.en:
$$カレン$$
「And the soul of $$アッセンブルＥＸ－１０$$ is still alive today.」

300:t_2:95.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「...We're not the only reason this country has been able to keep resisting.」

300:t_2:97.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「We're not exactly working hand in hand with them, but...」

300:t_2:98.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「It's those 《$$マーティアル$$》 folks.」

300:t_2:100.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What do a bunch of combat maniacs who claim battle makes humans evolve have to do with anything?」

300:t_2:101.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「Since around the time the civil war ended, people of $$マーティアル$$ have been pouring into $$クメン$$ as well.」

300:t_2:102.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「Since this country has many people from $$アストラギウス$$, it didn't take long for their faith to spread.」

300:t_2:103.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Seems they're on bad terms with the $$サイデリアル$$, so they fight the Empire on their own.」

300:t_2:104.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「...If we make use of that, we might be able to escape...」

300:t_2:106.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Emergency repairs on all our units are done. As long as the Empire is chasing us, staying long would only bring trouble on you as well.」

300:t_2:107.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Can't you just keep fighting alongside us...?」

300:t_2:108.en:
$$カレン$$
「Sorry, $$キデーラ$$... We have things we have to do.」

300:t_2:109.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Don't worry about it, $$カレン$$. Once things settle down, let's have a drink again.」

300:t_2:110.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「It's a place full of memories, after all. Next time, we'll have $$カレン$$ play the bunny girl.」

300:t_2:111.en:
$$カレン$$
「You're unbelievable, even at a time like this...!」

300:t_2:112.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Now that's something to look forward to, hey!」

300:t_2:113.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're the same, even at a time like this...」

300:t_2:114.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Fall for me all over again?」

300:t_2:115.en:
$$マオ$$
「...I do respect you. For how you never waver.」

300:t_2:116.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ゼロ$$... What do you intend to do once we leave here?」

300:t_2:117.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「First, we gather information. ...At the time of that $$時空震動$$, $$ヒイロ$$ and the others and $n were near us.」

300:t_2:118.en:
$$スザク$$
「You think they were thrown somewhere around Southeast Asia too?」

300:t_2:119.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Yes. We'll aim for $$メリダ島$$, where the $$ミスリル$$ base is, and try to link up with them.」

300:t_2:120.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「We're already calling out to them over secret comm codes, mixing in fakes and dummies.」

300:t_2:122.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That bastard was near us too. He's bound to have been thrown somewhere around here.」

300:t_2:124.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The black AS piloted by $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$...」

300:t_2:125.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That overwhelming combat power, which crushed even the $$アーバレスト$$, far exceeds any AS we know of.」

300:t_2:126.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「The brain of that man, who even built the $$時空震動弾$$, is truly both a marvel and a menace.」

300:t_2:127.en:
$$カレン$$
「And he took $$かなめ$$ away...」

300:t_2:128.en:
$$マオ$$
(So $$アマルガム$$ has finally gotten hold of $$カナメ$$... a $$ウィスパード$$...)

300:t_2:129.en:
$$クルツ$$
(With all that chaos... I doubt this information has even reached $$テッサ$$...)

300:t_2:130.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「...We've had word from Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$, who's scouting ahead. The $$サイデリアル$$ have moved the front west, and deployment on this side is thin, apparently.」
